mcq.s: Which of the following is NOT true about the Gol Gumbaz?
o: It is the tomb of Muhammad Adil Shah
There is no mosque and no arches near the tomb
Its dome is one of the largest of its kind in the world
mcq.x: The Gol Gumbaz at Bijapur is the tomb of Muhammad Adil Shah (1656); its huge dome rests on intersecting arches and the complex includes a mosque, so statement 2 is false.
